the specific image criteria for breast carcinoma are: (a) the presence of an irregular, ill-defined margin, (b) the presence of internal echoes, (c) the presence of posterior acoustic shadowing, and (d) a change in the echogenicity of breast tissue with time.

the echogram is a reflection of the histopathologic structure of the breast and its tumors.
